commands.name: nh-history-parity
argv:
import subprocess,sys
lane,fleet,cand=sys.argv[1:4]
fz=subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',lane,'cat-file','blob','4fe9339f8fc3a4a4a479d9c938a850da12f1124d:tools/report-landing-audit.py'])
bad=0
for r in ('10-21','10-22'):
 for m in ([],['--no-errata']):
  a=['--lane-repo',lane,'--fleet-repo',fleet,'--rounds',r,'--json',*m]
  c=subprocess.run([sys.executable,cand,*a],capture_output=True)
  f=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-',*a],input=fz,capture_output=True)
  ok=(c.returncode,c.stdout,c.stderr)==(f.returncode,f.stdout,f.stderr)
  bad|=not ok
  print(r,*m,'current',c.returncode,'frozen',f.returncode,'same' if ok else 'DIFF')
sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)
